fnviaviewer.pack.title: FNViaViewer: %s content
fnviaviewer.pack.description: Blocks, items and sounds from Minecraft %s, downloaded from Mojang
fnviaviewer.toast.download_failed.title: FNViaViewer
fnviaviewer.toast.download_failed.body: Couldn't download the %s assets. New blocks will look like older ones.
fnviaviewer.toast.download_done.title: FNViaViewer
fnviaviewer.config.title: FNViaViewer
fnviaviewer.config.enabled.tooltip: Translate the connection to servers on a newer version. When off, the game behaves like vanilla.
fnviaviewer.config.blocks.tooltip: Show blocks from the newer version. When off, they look like the closest older block.
fnviaviewer.config.items.tooltip: Show items from the newer version. When off, they look like the closest older item.
fnviaviewer.config.sounds.tooltip: Play sounds from the newer version. When off, older sounds are used.
fnviaviewer.config.particles.tooltip: Shows the new version's particles (poplar leaves, geysers). Off: the closest old ones are used.
fnviaviewer.config.entities.tooltip: Shows poplar boats and cushions as they really look. Off: they look like the closest old ones.
fnviaviewer.config.redownload.tooltip: Deletes the downloaded textures, models and sounds and downloads them again from Mojang.
fnviaviewer.config.rejoin: Changes apply fully after rejoining the server.
